name: aws_alb_high_5xx_rate
title: ALB 5xx error rate above 5%
description: More than 5% of an Application Load Balancer's requests got a 5xx (load balancer or target) in the last 10 minutes, with at least 100 requests. Users are seeing server errors. Deploys can cause short spikes.

query_condition.sql: SELECT res AS load_balancer, account_id, region, sum(CASE WHEN metric_name IN ('HTTPCode_ELB_5XX_Count', 'HTTPCode_Target_5XX_Count') THEN s ELSE 0 END) AS errors_5xx, sum(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'RequestCount' THEN s ELSE 0 END) AS requests FROM (SELECT dimensions_loadbalancer AS res, metric_name, account_id, region, timestamp, max(value_sum) AS s FROM "cloudwatch_metrics" WHERE namespace = 'AWS/ApplicationELB' AND metric_name IN ('RequestCount', 'HTTPCode_ELB_5XX_Count', 'HTTPCode_Target_5XX_Count') AND dimensions_loadbalancer IS NOT NULL GROUP BY res, metric_name, account_id, region, timestamp) AS t GROUP BY load_balancer, account_id, region HAVING sum(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'RequestCount' THEN s ELSE 0 END) >= 100 AND sum(CASE WHEN metric_name IN ('HTTPCode_ELB_5XX_Count', 'HTTPCode_Target_5XX_Count') THEN s ELSE 0 END) > 0.05 * sum(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'RequestCount' THEN s ELSE 0 END)
